summary: Implemented prepareUpdate and the Update container as specified, without running tests or installing anything (per instructions); all verification was by reading. Changes: sparql.py gains an Update container (prologue, algebra); algebra.py translateUpdate always returns an Update, building the prologue from q.prologue[0] on the empty path; update.py evalUpdate iterates update.algebra; processor.py adds prepareUpdate beside prepareQuery (SPARQLUpdateProcessor unchanged, it already passes non-strings through); __init__.py exports prepareUpdate; new test/test_sparql_prepare.py covers prepare/apply, reuse, initNs, direct evaluation, container shape, empty and declarations-only requests, empty string, and a no-mutation snapshot. Gaps: no test for initial bindings reaching operations; pprintAlgebra's debug output for update containers now prints a plain list. Nothing committed.
